Workshops, talks, and community for creative coders of all levels.
Date to be announced — register your interest now.

CC Fest is a free and friendly event for anyone curious about creative code. Come spend a few hours with us — make interactive and engaging digital art, animation, and games, work with AI or hardware, and explore many other options. Hear from keynote speakers on important and timely topics related to creative coding.
Students, artists, hobbyists, creatives, and tinkerers who are curious to learn
Educators and community organizers who are looking for inspiration
Everyone who would like to learn more about creative code and our community

We hosted our first virtual event on July 11, 2020. Previous in-person CC Fests
have taken place in New York City, Los Angeles, and San Francisco.

Want to organize a CC Fest in your city? Email Saber Khan.

Send an email to mrkhanatndv@gmail.com with the subject
line "Join mailing list" to get notified about upcoming events.

CC Fest is dedicated to providing a harassment-free experience for everyone. We do not tolerate harassment of participants in any form. This code of conduct applies to all CC Fest spaces — online and in-person — including chat channels, event venues, and social media.

Participants asked to stop any harassing behavior are expected to comply immediately. If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please contact mrkhanatndv@gmail.com.
